01e1c86d-f87e-41cb-aff3-914f38b14fd8/Eve.en: "The moon has its phases, and no person is perfect; I will do my best..."<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> solemnly buried the hilt of <color=#yellow>Vitalos</color> where the Demon-Sealing Light cast by Tainted fell.<NL>From within the Demon-Sealing Light, Yi Xiang materialized, smiling.<NL>Then, the Light emitted a brilliant glow, and Yi Xiang vanished...

e672d42d-9f44-4032-9ed8-6f72ebf673f6/Eve.en: "Shame to be looked at by others... shame to be looked at by others... past misdeeds should remain hidden..."<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> solemnly buried the hilt of <color=#yellow>Vitalos</color> where the Demon-Sealing Light cast by Tainted fell.<NL>From within the Demon-Sealing Light, Yi Xiang materialized, wailing.<NL>But soon, the Light dimmed, and Yi Xiang vanished...

eb92ec6d-c1e8-4c61-8341-a521256f660a/Eve.en: "..."<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> solemnly buried the hilt of <color=#yellow>Vitalos</color> where the Demon-Sealing Light cast by Tainted fell.<NL><color=#yellow>Vitalos</color> remains still, and the Light seems to fade away...
eb92ec6d-c1e8-4c61-8341-a521256f660a/Eve.ru: "..."<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> торжественно похоронил рукоять <color=#yellow>Виталоса</color> там, куда упал Демонический свет, отбрасываемый Испорченным.<NL><color=#yellow>Виталос</color> остается неподвижным, и Свет, кажется, гаснет...
